title: Offloading real-time stencil simulations to mobile NPUs: code, models and measurements
description:
Benchmark harnesses (macOS, iOS, Android), Core ML and LiteRT graph builders, compiled models, recorded fluid traces and every measurement for the paper Offloading Real-Time Stencil Simulations to Mobile Neural Processing Units: Overhead, Placement, and Correctness (J. T. Tarigan and R. F. Rahmat, submitted to the Journal of Systems Architecture).

Code: PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. Data, models, traces and documentation: CC BY 4.0. See README.md.
